## MidnightApiError class

Thrown when the Midnight API returns a non-2xx response.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class MidnightApiError extends Error
```
**Extends:** Error

## Example


```ts
import { MidnightApiError } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk/api";

throw new MidnightApiError({
  status: 400,
  code: "BAD_REQUEST",
  message: "Limit must be greater than 0.",
  details: [{ field: "limit", issue: "Limit must be greater than 0." }],
  requestId: "req-123",
});
```
